description: Google OAuth Integration: Implement callback route with manual account linking to prevent duplicate doctor accounts. Add 'Continue with Google' buttons to login page and doctor page. Existing lib/auth-config.ts already has Google provider configured with clientId and clientSecret.
steps: 1. Create app/api/auth/callback/google/route.ts: Receive code param, exchange for tokens using OAuth2Client from google-auth-library, verify ID token, extract email/sub/name/picture.

2. In callback route: Check db.select().from(users).where(eq(users.email, email)) for existing user. If doctor role, verify doctors table has profile via db.select().from(doctors).where(eq(doctors.userId, user.id)).
3. If existing user: Link googleId by updating users table SET googleId = sub, emailVerified = true. Create accounts table record with providerId='google', accountId=sub, userId=user.id.
4. If new user AND doctor role: Return error 'Doctor account must be provisioned by center admin first'. If new user AND patient/center: Create via Better Auth (follow existing signup pattern).
5. Create session: Use auth.api.createSession({ userId, expiresIn: 86400 }), set cookie 'better-auth.session_token' with httpOnly, secure, sameSite='lax'.
6. Create lib/auth/google-oauth-helper.ts with functions: linkGoogleAccount(userId, googleId, tokens), validateDoctorProfile(userId), createOAuthSession(userId). Reuse these in callback route.
7. Modify app/login/page.tsx: Change handleGoogleSignIn function to redirect: window.location.href = '/api/auth/signin/google'. Remove 'not yet implemented' error message.
8. Test OAuth flow: Click Google button on /login, redirects to Google consent, redirects back to /api/auth/callback/google, creates session, redirects to role-appropriate dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: Existing patient with email@gmail.com can sign in with Google without creating duplicate account
Provisioned doctor with email@gmail.com can sign in with Google and gets redirected to /doctor
Non-provisioned email trying Google OAuth gets error 'Doctor account must be provisioned by center admin'
Google button on /login page redirects to Google OAuth consent screen
After successful OAuth, user lands on correct dashboard based on role (CENTER → /center, DOCTOR → /doctor, PATIENT → /patient, ADMIN → /admin)
verification: Check database: users table has googleId populated, emailVerified = true
Check database: accounts table has new record with providerId='google'
Try logging in again with same Google account: No duplicate user created, session created immediately
findings:
✅ IMPLEMENTATION COMPLETE

1. Better Auth Native OAuth: Better Auth handles OAuth callback route automatically via /api/auth/[...all]/route.ts - no need for custom callback route.

2. Account Linking Configuration: Added accountLinking config in lib/auth/server.ts with enabled: true, trustedProviders: ['google', 'email-password'], and allowDifferentEmails: false to automatically link Google accounts to existing users with matching emails.

3. Doctor Validation Hook: Implemented user.validateUserInfo hook in lib/auth/server.ts to validate doctor profiles during OAuth sign-in. Prevents non-provisioned doctors from creating accounts via Google OAuth.

4. Helper Functions: Created lib/auth/google-oauth-helper.ts with linkGoogleAccount(), validateDoctorProfile(), findUserByEmail(), hasGoogleAccountLinked(), and getDashboardUrl() utility functions.

5. Login Page: Already configured to use authClient.signIn.social({ provider: 'google' }) - Better Auth client handles redirect to Google OAuth consent screen automatically.

6. Package Installation: Installed google-auth-library@11.3.1 (though Better Auth handles OAuth internally, library available for future custom implementations).

7. Middleware Migration: Migrated middleware.ts to proxy.ts per Next.js 16 deprecation warning.

8. Database Schema: users table already has googleId field, accounts table exists for OAuth provider linkage.

Better Auth Flow:
- User clicks 'Sign in with Google' → authClient.signIn.social() redirects to /api/auth/signin/google
- Better Auth redirects to Google OAuth consent screen
- After consent, Google redirects to /api/auth/callback/google
- Better Auth exchanges code for tokens, fetches user profile, checks for existing user by email
- If existing user: creates account record, sets googleId, creates session
- If new user: validateUserInfo hook validates (blocks non-provisioned doctors)
- Session created, user redirected to dashboard based on role

READY FOR TESTING
